## Change

Describe the single feature/fix and why it is needed. Link a task if available.

## Verification

- [ ] Read `AGENTS.md` and updated `HANDOFF.md` / `CHANGELOG.md` as applicable.
- [ ] Preserved app identity, existing behavior, and user data, or documented owner-approved changes.
- [ ] Reported exact checks run and distinguished static, build, unit, and Android-device results.
- [ ] Tested affected sensitive-field and IME lifecycle behavior, or explicitly marked not run.
- [ ] Added no private keys, tokens, user typing logs, clipboard data, or unsolicited networking.
- [ ] For a release: recorded version, reproducible build, checksum, signer and upgrade limitations.

### Not Tested / Known Limitations

State missing source/tools/devices or unfinished work. A green archive check is not a successful Android build.
